verdict.headline: Xero allows self-serve development for up to 20 pilot organizations, but App Store certification and advanced endpoints face strict review, pricing tiers, and AI data training bans.
verdict.timeToFirstConnection: 15 to 30 minutes using a free Xero developer account and the built-in demo company.
verdict.timeToProduction: Immediate for up to 20 pilot organizations; several weeks if seeking Xero App Store certification or access to restricted endpoints like Journals.
verdict.timeToProductionShort: Immediate for 20 orgs; weeks for App Store
verdict.handsOnEffort: Creating an OAuth app, configuring granular scopes, managing 30-minute access token refreshes via `offline_access`, and ensuring Xero API data is not used for AI model training.
verdict.cost: Free to build and test; effective March 2026, Xero uses tiered monthly API pricing based on egress data, with higher fees for restricted endpoints.
verdict.biggestRisk: Using Xero API data to train or fine-tune AI/ML models is strictly prohibited, which can cause app rejection or partner termination.

permissions.name: offline_access
permissions.purpose: Obtain refresh tokens to maintain API connectivity after the short 30-minute access token lifespan.
permissions.notes: Essential for background and unattended agent execution.

permissions.name: accounting.transactions.read / granular equivalents
permissions.purpose: Read invoices, payments, and transactional data for accounting sync.
permissions.notes: Apps created on or after March 2, 2026, must use granular domain-specific scopes.

permissions.name: Journals (/api.xro/2.0/Journals)
permissions.notes: Requires Advanced pricing tier ($1,445 AUD/mo), explicit use-case approval, and security assessment.

permissions.name: bankfeeds
permissions.purpose: Direct access to bank feed integrations.
permissions.notes: Managed under a separate certification process and contractual agreements.

nuances.title: 30-Minute Access Token Expiration
nuances.detail: Access tokens expire after 30 minutes; omitting `offline_access` prevents receiving a refresh token, breaking persistent automation.

nuances.title: Strict AI/ML Model Training Prohibition
nuances.detail: Xero developer terms strictly prohibit using data retrieved via the API to train or fine-tune machine learning or AI models.

nuances.title: Pilot Limit of 20 Organizations
nuances.detail: Uncertified integrations are limited to a maximum of 20 active connected organizations.

nuances.title: Mandatory Granular Scopes
nuances.detail: Apps created on or after March 2, 2026, cannot use broad legacy scopes and must request precise granular permissions.

blockers.symptom: App certification rejection or integration termination if Xero data pipelines feed into AI model training.
blockers.howToProceed: Architect data pipelines to ensure Xero data is strictly isolated to user execution and explicitly excluded from ML training sets.

blockers.symptom: API calls fail with '401 WWW-Authenticate: insufficient_scope'.
blockers.howToProceed: Update the scope list in your OAuth authorization request to include the specific granular scope required and ask the user to re-authorize.

drafts.title: Scope Justification for App Review
drafts.purpose: Explain requested granular scopes during Xero certification.
drafts.content: Our app [APP_NAME] provides automated invoice and contact reconciliation for small businesses. We request `accounting.contacts.read` and `accounting.transactions.read` solely to query existing customer records and pending invoices to display status inside [APP_NAME]. We also request `offline_access` so that background processing can sync data without requiring daily user re-authentication. No data retrieved from Xero is used for machine learning or AI model training.

drafts.title: Demo Video Script for Certification
drafts.purpose: Guide for recording the required demo video for Xero App Store review.
drafts.content: 1. Start on [APP_NAME] login page and click 'Sign In with Xero'. 2. Show redirection to Xero consent screen displaying requested granular scopes. 3. Select the Xero demo organisation and grant access. 4. Show initial data pull (invoices/contacts) inside [APP_NAME]. 5. Demonstrate perform action (e.g. creating an invoice or viewing a sync report). 6. Demonstrate 'Update Permissions' flow if additional scopes are requested.

claimChecks.evidence: Store the refresh_token securely. It s what allows your app to continue working after the 30-minute access token expires without asking the user to reconnect.

claimChecks.claim: Strict AI/ML Model Training Prohibition: Xero developer terms strictly prohibit using data retrieved via the API to train or fine-tune machine learning or AI models.
claimChecks.evidence: As of December 2025, Xero's updated developer terms explicitly prohibit using data accessed via the Xero API to train AI or machine learning models.

claimChecks.claim: Active Customer Connections: Between 3 and 10 active customer connections in a 30-day window required for App Store certification.
claimChecks.evidence: Certification requires 10 customers with active Xero connections — not 10 signups, 10 live connections.

claimChecks.claim: Demo Video & Test Credentials: Required for Xero team during formal App Store certification review.
claimChecks.evidence: Once you’ve got your integration built, the next step is to set up a time to demo this to XERO. Generally, we first prepare a full-flow video of how the integration works, and what it does. This ensures that the team at XERO know exactly what they need to look out for and test when given demo/test credentials to your product.

claimChecks.evidence: Certification requires 10 customers with active Xero connections — not 10 signups, 10 live connections.
